title: Base change along $T$, geometric fibres
statement:
Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] and let $T$ be a scheme over $S$ [def-weil-scheme-over-base], with structure morphism $T\to S$. The *base change* of $X$ along $T\to S$ is the fibre product [def-pc-fibre-product]

$$
X_T:=X\times_ST,\qquad
\mathrm{pr}_T:X_T\longrightarrow T,\qquad
f_T:X_T\longrightarrow X,
$$

with its two projections; $X_T$ is a scheme over $T$ through $\mathrm{pr}_T$. For a morphism $h:X\to Y$ of schemes over $S$, the *base change of $h$* is the induced morphism of fibre products $h_T:=h\times_S\mathrm{id}_T:X_T\to Y_T$, a morphism of schemes over $T$; in particular, for $g:T'\to T$ a morphism of schemes over $S$, the induced morphism $g_X:=\mathrm{id}_X\times_Sg:X_{T'}\to X_T$ identifies $X_{T'}$ with $X_T\times_TT'$. For a sheaf of $\mathcal O_{X_T}$-modules $\mathcal F$ on $X_T$ and $g:T'\to T$ as above, the *base change of the module* $\mathcal F$ is the pullback [def-pc-module-pullback] $\mathcal F_{T'}=g_X^*\mathcal F$ along $g_X:X_{T'}\to X_T$. For a point $t\in T$ the *fibre* $X_t=X\times_S\operatorname{Spec}(\kappa(t))$ is the scheme-theoretic fibre [def-pc-scheme-fibre] of $\mathrm{pr}_T$ over $t$, where $\kappa(t)$ is the residue field [def-weil-residue-field] and $\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(t)\to T\to S$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] the canonical morphism; the *geometric fibre* $X_{\bar t}=X\times_S\operatorname{Spec}\overline{\kappa(t)}$, for a chosen algebraic closure $\overline{\kappa(t)}$ of $\kappa(t)$, and *geometric points* are as in Definition [def-weil-geometric-point].
If $f$ has a section [def-pc-section] $\sigma:S\to X$ and $T$ is over $S$, then the *induced section* is the base change of $\sigma$, regarded as a morphism $S\to X$ of schemes over $S$: $\sigma_T:=\sigma\times_S\mathrm{id}_T:T=S\times_ST\to X_T$, the unique morphism with $\mathrm{pr}_T\circ\sigma_T=\mathrm{id}_T$ and $f_T\circ\sigma_T=\sigma\circ(T\to S)$; it is a section of $\mathrm{pr}_T$.

split_report.summary: Checked the statement against the master blueprint node (order 451; slopmaster2 has no copy of this node). The blueprint's text names, without defining them, the fibre product of schemes with its projections and induced morphisms, the pullback of a sheaf of modules along a morphism of schemes, the scheme-theoretic fibre over a point, and a section of a morphism; none of these had a node (the DAG's def-weil-pbc-inverse-image, def-pc-derived-pullback and def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square are the etale, derived and etale-square versions). Each became a definition node of its own, stated from Stacks Tags 01JP/001V, 0095/0096, 01K0/01K1 and (for sections) the categorical definition, and each is a Mathlib leaf: CategoryTheory.Limits.pullback with HasPullbacks Scheme, Scheme.Modules.pullback, Scheme.Hom.fiber and CategoryTheory.SplitEpi, line numbers verified in the Mathlib copy. The statement keeps the blueprint's notation (f_T for the projection to X) and was made precise where the blueprint was loose: the base change of a morphism of schemes over S is spelled out (Tag 01JX (6)), because the blueprint's g_X and sigma_T are instances of it; the fibre X_t is identified as the fibre of pr_T over t with the residue field and Spec cited (reviewed leaves def-weil-residue-field, def-weil-affine-spectrum); the induced section is written as the base change of sigma with its characterizing equations, and it is recorded to be a section of pr_T. Scheme over a base now points to the reviewed leaf def-weil-scheme-over-base. The geometric fibre and geometric points stay pointed at def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, as the blueprint says; they are not defined here. def-pc-morphism-conventions was removed from stmt_deps: the statement uses no morphism property, and its reference to def:weil-pbc-scheme-conventions is now direct.

lean.statement: def Scheme.Modules.moduleBaseChange (f : X ⟶ S) {T T' : Over S} (g : T' ⟶ T) : (Limits.pullback f T.hom).Modules ⥤ (Limits.pullback f T'.hom).Modules
lean.note: Bundle of conventions. Scheme and morphism base change reuse CategoryTheory.Over.pullback; g_X and induced sections reuse AlgebraicGeometry.baseChangeMap and sectionBaseChange from slopmaster2. The module records the comparison clauses and adds module base change using the dependency tensorPullback, and the geometric fibre at a point with an arbitrary chosen algebraic closure. Citers needing X_T use `Limits.pullback f T.hom` (pr_T = `pullback.snd`, f_T = `pullback.fst`); `moduleBaseChange` is only module base change.
